notes.title: 100% fix bug Mouse Sensibility + Controller
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
New update that fix 100% the mouse sensibility. Sorry for this bug and thanks for reporting it.
If you was facing this sensibility issue, make sure to have game version 1.9.3 or above in both paid and demo versions.
If you want to play with keyboard and mouse make sure first to remove any controller connected to your pc, because when a controller is connected the game will try to use the controller right analog to controls view rotation.
When you connect the controller first time make sure first to reset input settings to let the game loads the default mappings for Xbox or Playstation controllers.
Other controllers are supported too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41208536/b40b445ed02bf8e7116b94b90ceb2806d801afc6.png[/img]

notes.title: Big performance boost in both the paid and the free demo version
notes.content:
We just updated both the paid and the free demo version with these new features:

- big performance boost: this time its a CPU boost, as we noticed that some old processors had performance drop even with a good graphic card, we just fixed this issue and now the game should works more faster for every one, in older low performant pc, we highly recommend switching to settings->graphics->medium, then try the game, if it still slow, reduce your resolution from settings->resolution
- Updated the player Arms to looks better (a bit dirty and realistic skin)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41208536/a96dca8ee9aa4fdc459e0764c04aa8fd685b8842.png[/img]

notes.title: We just updated both the paid and the free demo version
notes.content:

Note: Players from free demo can't get GP ou in game Cash so limited to default weapons: AKM, M9 Pistol, and Knife

notes.title: Fire On Fight is Now Released in Early Access
notes.content:
The time to release our Shooter Game Fire On Fight has come! and since the game is not yet fully finished, we released it in Early Access.
The game now has only one playable map, but a second Map 'Military Base' in great night ambience is 100% finished and will be available in 2 days from now, all the other maps are 90% finished so we will be publishing a new map each 3 to 5 days.
For the weapons only 18 in total are available now, the full game should have at least 40 weapons, left weapons are 90% finished and will be available in each 4 to 5 days updates.
for Full Controller support and Input customization setting, it will be available in next 2 weeks.
And with your support, we will keep adding new maps ,new weapons, new characters, pearks, accessoires... even after fully finishing the game, so we hope you will have fun playing our game, and we will be waiting for your feedbacks to make it more and more fun multiplayer shooter experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41208536/9dbcdc320dccd82d994c8f261790b39520103c65.png[/img]

notes.title: Fire On Fight Playable Demo Now Available
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have just released our Fire On Fight playable Demo to participate in Steam Next Fest event starting today February 21st, the demo will still be available after the event is over for a while, we invite everyone to try it, the accounts you create for the game will still be available even after the game is officially released, and you will keep all the items offered to you in the demo even if those items are locked after the game launches. Be sure to Wishlist and follow the game if you like it to be notified when released. Stay informed of our next news and events, it's still in development and the final version will surely be better and will have a lot of content to discover.

Thank you
